rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 4 "3. Get the content folder onto your laptop": line 45: "Ask Claude to fetch `ae101-content.tar.gz` to `~/Downloads/`." — the chunk's only action is downloading a compressed archive to ~/Downloads; nothing in this chunk extracts it into a folder. Extraction into an actual directory happens in the NEXT chunk (line 68-70: "Ensure my AE101 content directory exists... Extract ~/Downloads/ae101-content.tar.gz into that AE101 content directory"). At this chunk's own scope, the header "Get the content folder" overclaims what the step delivers (a .tar.gz file, not a folder).
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reword the header to name what this step actually does (e.g. "Download the content bundle"), or leave the folder framing to the following extract step's header.
